segments.name: Wholesale Footwear
segments.description: Designs, sources, and markets footwear brands to department stores, mass merchants, and retailers globally.
segments.evidence: Our Wholesale Footwear segment designs, sources, and markets our brands and sells our products, consisting of footwear, to department stores, mass merchants, off-price retailers, shoe chains, online retailers, national chains, specialty retailers, independent stores, and clubs throughout the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, and Mexico.

segments.name: Wholesale Accessories/Apparel
segments.description: Designs, sources, and markets handbags and apparel brands to retailers throughout the United States and internationally.
segments.evidence: Our Wholesale Accessories/Apparel segment designs, sources, and markets our brands and sells our products, primarily consisting of handbags and apparel, to department stores, mass merchants, off-price retailers, online retailers, specialty retailers, independent stores, and clubs throughout the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, and Mexico.

segments.name: Direct-to-Consumer
segments.description: Sells footwear, handbags, apparel, and accessories through retail stores, outlet stores, concessions, and e-commerce platforms globally.
segments.evidence: Our Direct-to-Consumer segment engages in the sale of footwear, handbags, apparel, and other trend accessories through Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger, Carvela, Dolce Vita, and ATM full-price retail stores, Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger and Carvela outlet stores, directly-operated concessions in international markets, and directly-operated e-commerce platforms.

segments.name: Licensing
segments.description: Licenses trademarks for apparel, accessories, and home categories with royalties based on licensee revenue.
segments.evidence: Our Licensing segment engages in the licensing of the Steve Madden ® , Kurt Geiger ® , and Betsey Johnson ® trademarks for use in the sale of select apparel, accessories, and home categories as well as various other non-core products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay wholesale and direct-to-consumer retailers for footwear, accessories, and apparel; licensees pay royalties based on revenue and sales percentage for advertising.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of our license agreements require the licensee to pay the Company a royalty based on actual revenue, a minimum royalty in the event predetermined revenue targets are not achieved and a percentage of sales for brand advertising.

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired Kurt Geiger and Carvela trademarks via acquisition of Mercury Acquisitions Topco Limited.
changes.evidence: In May 2025, we acquired the Kurt Geiger ® trademark via our acquisition of Mercury Acquisitions Topco Limited ("MATL"), the ultimate parent company of Kurt Geiger.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired the ATM brand in November 2024.
changes.evidence: ATM was founded in 2012, and we acquired the ATM brand in November 2024.
